turns: I wake to my alarm, strap my late father's old field watch onto my wrist, and head out to meet Kotori at the corner.
On the walk I ask Kotori if she's ever actually been inside the forest at night.
In homeroom I go over and introduce myself to the transfer student in the back row.
At break I quietly ask the others what Kijima actually did at his last school.
At lunch I let Moriyama walk me to the clubroom and ask what the occult society actually investigates.
I study the corkboard photos and ask her why every single one is blurred the same way — then I sign the membership form.
After school I help Tsuchiya retie the trellises on the rooftop and ask her about the weather station hum.
On the way home I stop at the shrine supply shop and let the old shopkeeper press a little wooden charm on me.
At dusk I walk toward the north gate with Kotori and stop where the lamplight ends, looking for the girl with the ribbon.
I ask the girl with the ribbon whether she can hear the hum too.
Back in my room after curfew, I turn my father's watch over in my fingers and watch the canopy for the light to pulse again.
